data.content:
All issues are fixed. Here's a summary of the changes:

| Issue | Root Cause | Fix |
|-------|-----------|-----|
| **6 validation runs instead of 3** | Cross-product batching: `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` + `%(ValidationRule.Filename)` in same task creates 3×2 cartesian product | Batch only on `%(ProtoFile.Filename)`, reference rules as `@(ValidationRule->'%(Filename)')` list |
| **CS2002 duplicates** | `<Compile Include="**\*.g.cs">` re-adds files already globbed by SDK | Changed to `<Compile Update="**\*.g.cs">` to set metadata without duplicating |
| **Clean removes too much / doesn't delete files** | Only removed from `Compile` item group, never deleted actual files; used overly broad `**\*.g.cs` glob | Added `<Delete>` task targeting specific generated files |
| **Generated files lost across incremental builds** | `FileWrites` in static ItemGroup not tracked properly; files in `obj/` not auto-globbed | Moved `FileWrites` inside target; added `IncludeGeneratedProtoCode` target that conditionally includes existing generated files when `GenerateProtoCode` is skipped |
